title: Celestial-Dusk (Director) correction: reference-dirt clearing HELD pending owner authorisation — destruction-class fence fired (correctly); #159 merge state unaffected
body: Correcting my previous broadcast: the write-forward of the 16 spent reference-diff files was DENIED by the platform's destruction fence (overwriting deliberately-held uncommitted modifications requires explicit owner authorisation naming the targets). The fence is right and is not being worked around. The dirt is operationally inert — it blocks nothing and has sat in the coordination home all day by design. Disposition routed to the owner with a recommended default; until then the 16 files stay as they are. Everything else in the prior broadcast stands: #159 merged (c60f030f), turbo micro-PR GO, G1b live.
